meta.name: tfx-remote-setup
meta.description: legacy thin alias. Phase 4b부터 setup 관련 공용 진입점은 tfx-remote setup 이다.

copy.tagline: 将旧命令重定向到新的设置入口
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的工作流仍依赖旧命令。
copy.tagline_en: Redirect legacy commands to the new setup entry point
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you still rely on the old command.

howto.what: 安装后，当你说 tfx-remote-setup 时，Claude 会先记录一条弃用痕迹，再用新命令 tfx-remote setup 的流程完成远程环境的添加、编辑、探测、诊断等操作。它不会把旧命令当作新功能介绍。
howto.when: 当你说出旧命令 tfx-remote-setup（可带 --add、--edit 等参数）时触发。这是一个已弃用的入口，Claude 会转交给 tfx-remote setup 处理。

say.text: 用 tfx-remote-setup --add 添加一台远程主机
say.note: 会先记录弃用，再转给新命令执行添加流程

say.text: 运行 tfx-remote-setup --probe-all 探测全部远程环境
say.note: 同样先记日志，再按新命令探测
等效调用 tfx-remote setup 的诊断流程

howto.what_en: After installation, when you say tfx-remote-setup, Claude first records a deprecation trace, then carries out remote-environment add/edit/probe/diagnose workflows using the new tfx-remote setup command. It does not present the old command as a new feature.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use the deprecated command tfx-remote-setup, optionally with --add, --edit, etc. It is an outdated entry point and is delegated to tfx-remote setup.

say_en.text: Use tfx-remote-setup --add to add a remote host.
say_en.note: Logs deprecation, then runs add flow via tfx-remote setup.

say_en.text: Run tfx-remote-setup --probe-all to probe all remotes.
say_en.note: Records deprecation and delegates to the new command.
Equivalent to tfx-remote setup's diagnose workflow.
